tei:div.tei:p: ༈ bar do'i smon lam ngo sprod bzhugs so/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gi thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba des/ /bdag gzhan ma lus byang chub thob par shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /lam zab rdzogs chen snying po'i don rtogs nas/ /chos nyid mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs shing*/ /zag bcas phung po 'od skur grol bar shog /gnad gcod drag po'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ /bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mig gi dbang por mngon sum byon nas ni/ /dbang bskur lung ston mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /'dus byas mi rtag 'chi ba byung tsa na/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs chad bems rig bral ba'i tshe/ / zhen chags 'khrul pa'i snang ba mi 'char bar/ /gnas lugs chos sku'i ngang la gnas par shog /sgyu lus gdos bcas 'jog pa dus babs na/ /snang phung phra rags rtog pa 'gag pa'i tshe/ /'khrul med khyab gdal gdod ma'i dbyings chen la/ /bems rig bral ma thag tu grol bar shog /ma dag 'byung ba so sor dengs pa'i tshe/ /dag pa'i 'od lnga ma 'dres 'od gsal dang*/ /rtog med 'od lnga rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /dbyer med gcig 'dres chos nyid mthar phyin shog /hūm̐ chen khros pa'i srin po'i gzugs la sogs/ /hūm̐ sgras stong gsum ma lus gang tsa na/ /rig stong hūm̐ sgra'i gnad du ngo shes nas/ /grags stong brag ca lta bur rtogs par shog /gshin rje'i gshed ma'i tshogs kyis bskor tsa na/ /rgyob sod 'bros 'ded 'khrul ba dbyings dag nas/ /bred sngangs 'khrul ba'i snang ba mi 'char bar/ /yid dam zhi khro'i sku ru shes par shog /dung khang 'bar ba'i bde chen gzhal yas nas/ khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs rnams gyes pa'i tshe/ /'jigs gzugs srin po'i sku ru+u mi 'char bar/ /man ngag snying tig dgongs pa'i don rtogs shog

/tsit+ta rin chen gur khang gzhal yas nas/ /zhi ba'i tshogs rnams dbyings su yal ba'i tshe/ /snang ba ru log 'od skur shar ba'i dus/ /rig pa 'od kyi klong du thim par shog /mgrin mgul rtsa yi 'khor lo dral ba'i tshe/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyang 'brug stong ldir tsa na/ /āḥ hūm̐ zhi khro'i gdangs su ngo shes nas/ /rig stong skye med sgra ru grol bar shog /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas/ /thabs shes dkar dmar snying gar phrad tsa na/ /bde stong zag pa med pa'i gnas lugs de/ /rlung rig dbu ma'i nang du tshud par shog /chos nyid bar do'i ngang la gnas pa'i tshe/ /shes rig lung ma bstan du ma song bar/ /rang grol ka dag chen po'i don rtogs te/ /gzhan stong chos zad ngang la gnas par shog /chos nyid mngon sum bden pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /gnyen po dran 'dzin sgom pa'i blo bral nas/ /ka dag zad sar 'khyol ba'i don rtogs te/ /rtog med spros bral ngang la gnas par shog /'ja' tshon sna lnga 'dres pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /ye shes lnga yi gur khang sgo phye ste/ /sku dang thig les zhing khams gang ba'i tshe/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang mjal bar shog /thig le stong sgron 'od gsal gzhal yas su/ /lhun grub sbubs la brtan pa mthar phyin nas/ / dbyings rig nam mkha'i ngang du 'pho bar shog /chos sku stong gsal sgron me 'bar bar shog /stong nyid rig pa'i chos sku thob par shog /'gag med gnyis snang longs sku thob par shog /rang rig mthar phyin sprul sku thob par shog /sku gsum thob nas gzhan don byed par shog /ces 'chi kha bar do dang chos nyid bar do'i smon lam thos pas grol ba kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // a+thi+-iḥ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod legs par nyon/ khyod lus gdos bcas phung po shul du bor/ /da lta rnam shes rten med bar dor 'khyams//'di dus dkon mchog min pa skyabs gnas med/

/da ni shul gyis zas nor nye du sogs/ /skad cid tsam yang yid la ma byed par/ /bar do'i dus 'dir bar dor shes par gyis/ /rang gi yid lus yi dam lha ru sgoms/ /cir snang mi bden rmi lam sgyu mar ltos/ /phan gnod lha 'dre'i gzugs dang mi snyan sgra/ /sa g.yo ri 'gul shing 'degs mtsho 'khrug dang*/ /mun nag sros dang gnam grum sgra chen sogs/ /'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba'i 'khrul snang mthong ba'i tshe/ /rmi lam snang ba ci 'drar shes par gyis/ /nam mkha' cis kyang gzhig par mi nus ltar/ khyod kyis yid lus stong pa de la ni/ /srid gsum dgra ru langs kyang ci byar yod/ /rang gis rang la 'khrul par ma byed par/ /gzugs snang thams cad lha sku sgyu mar ltos/ /sgra tshogs ci grags yi dam lha yi sngags/ /rang sems stong pa skye med chos skur zhog /spyi bo'i gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma sgoms/ /mi 'bral gus pas gdung shugs gsol ba thob/ /snod bcud rang gzhan bcas pa 'di kun kyang*/ /brdar btags tsam ste gcig dang tha dad med/ /thams cad rang sems snying po gcig tu dril/ / a yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar ba yis/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /rnam dag yon tan bgrang las 'das pa de/ /mig gi drung na 'dug pa lta bur ltos/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med/ /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan pa/ /mtshan dpe dpag yas bltar mi ngoms pa de'i/ /thugs ka'i dbus su rang sems dbyer med bsres/ /zab mo chos kyi dbyings su mnyam bzhag go /zhes rang gzhan gyi yid dang rna bar nges par byas na srid pa bar dor grol ba thob pa'i rten 'brel yod pas do gal gyis ched du 'bad par gyis shig //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) bar do'i smon lam ngo sprod/ -PAGE 464--PAGE 465--PAGE 462-
